label: Bible Study
prompt: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; _____ to that which is good.
verse: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
note: Love without faking it — hate the evil, and hold on tight to the good.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly _____: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verse: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
note: Near the end of his life, Paul is still sure: the Lord will deliver him and bring him safe to His heavenly kingdom.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Ye are our _____ written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
verse: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
note: Paul tells the Corinthians they are his letter of recommendation — written on hearts, read by everyone.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and _____, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
verse: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
note: The first church's four habits after Pentecost: teaching, fellowship, bread and prayer — still a decent checklist.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and _____ the word with signs following. Amen.
verse: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
note: Mark's Gospel closes with the apostles preaching everywhere and the Lord 'confirming the word with signs following.'
